learning_outcomes.text: Explain the types, sources, composition, and characterization methods of solid waste.
Interpret the fundamental principles, hierarchy, and relevant legislation/standards of solid waste management.
Apply the design principles and calculations of solid waste collection, transport, and transfer station systems.
Explain the operating principles of disposal/recovery methods such as recycling, composting, biomethanization, incineration, and sanitary landfilling.
Analyze the solid waste quantity, composition, and appropriate management methods for a settlement or institution using mass balances and basic calculations.
Evaluate solid waste management systems in terms of environmental, economic, sustainability, and public health aspects, and develop appropriate solution proposals.

syllabus_topics: Effects of solid waste on the environment
Engineering systems in solid waste management
Engineering systems for energy conversion and sources
Incineration of solid waste, gasification, pyrolysis, anaerobic digestion
